schema.description: Usage limit assignment with bounds for new actions and model allowlists. Responses preserve legacy policies accepted by earlier writers.

allOf.description: A configured usage limit. Ordinary limits require value and their existing allocation mode. Phase 1 exposes the workspace premium policy only at DEFAULT_USER with client_id *. That key forbids value and allocation_mode and requires actions, containing zero or one RESTRICT_MODELS action. Ordinary actions-only policies, per-rule model restrictions, model targets, usage filters, daily windows, and restricted continuation are not supported.

target.description: Population and spend client governed by this limit.

x-enumDescriptions.ORGANIZATION: Shared limit across the organization for the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.DEFAULT_USER: Default per-user limit for the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.DEFAULT_AGENT: Default aggregate limit applied to agents without an agent-specific limit.
x-enumDescriptions.USER: Limit for one user, identified by canonical user ID or email, and the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.AGENT: Aggregate limit for one canonical agent ID, independent of spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.IDP_GROUP: Response-only source of an inherited per-user IdP-group limit.
x-enumDescriptions.DEPARTMENT: Response-only source of an inherited per-user department limit.

client_id.description: Opaque, case-sensitive spend-client ID, such as glean or an external gateway spend-client ID. Case and leading or trailing padding are preserved exactly; this is not inferred from the authenticating OAuth application, prefixed, or normalized. Empty and whitespace-only IDs (including Unicode whitespace), synthetic UI aggregation IDs, and control characters are invalid. Unknown IDs are valid and can have no applicable configured policies. Required for ORGANIZATION, DEFAULT_USER, and USER configurations; forbidden for configured aggregate DEFAULT_AGENT and AGENT policies. Evaluation always requires a concrete client, including for agents. The reserved * client is valid only for the Phase 1 DEFAULT_USER actions-only premium policy, not a cross-client budget or evaluation client. Omission never selects Glean or acts as a wildcard.

user_id.description: Canonical user ID; valid only when type is USER. A USER target requires user_id, email, or both.

email.description: Email address of the user, including a known alias email; valid only when type is USER. Matching is case-insensitive and resolves to the canonical user_id. When user_id is also supplied, both must identify the same user. Email is never part of the stored limit key. Responses include the user's directory email when one is available.

agent_id.description: Canonical agent ID; required only when type is AGENT.

target.title: PlatformUsageTarget

x-enumDescriptions.RECURRING_CALENDAR_MONTH: Resets at the start of each calendar month.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.RECURRING_CALENDAR_MONTH: Resets at the start of each calendar month.

allocation_mode.description: SHARED_POOL for ORGANIZATION and PER_MEMBER for ordinary DEFAULT_USER and DEFAULT_AGENT. Forbidden for USER, AGENT, and DEFAULT_USER/*.

x-enumDescriptions.SHARED_POOL: A single shared budget for the target population.
x-enumDescriptions.PER_MEMBER: A separate budget for each member of the target population.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.SHARED_POOL: A single shared budget for the target population.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.PER_MEMBER: A separate budget for each member of the target population.

allocation_mode.title: PlatformAllocationMode

value.description: Required for ordinary limits; forbidden for DEFAULT_USER/*.

mode.description: Whether the limit has a finite cap or is unlimited.

x-enumDescriptions.FINITE: A finite value; amount is required for a configured cap and remaining for headroom.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.FINITE: A finite value; amount is required for a configured cap and remaining for headroom.

mode.title: PlatformAmountMode

amount.description: Plain non-negative decimal amount with at most six fractional digits; required when mode is FINITE and forbidden when mode is UNLIMITED. Limits use single-precision (float32) storage: inputs are rounded to that precision, and responses report the stored value rounded to six fractional digits. For example, 100.10 can be returned as 100.099998. This storage limitation does not reduce the precision of measured usage counters.

unit.description: Unit for the selected spend domain; must match its billing denomination. Aggregate agent limits use the workspace plan denomination.
unit.title: PlatformUsageUnit

enforcement.description: How the limit is enforced when reached.

x-enumDescriptions.HARD: Configured hard cap; when enforced, requests are blocked at the limit.
x-enumDescriptions.SOFT: Configured soft cap; when enforced, requests are allowed but flagged at the limit.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.HARD: Configured hard cap; when enforced, requests are blocked at the limit.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.SOFT: Configured soft cap; when enforced, requests are allowed but flagged at the limit.

Whether the limit has a finite cap or is unlimited.

value.title: PlatformUsageLimitValue

actions.description: Ordered threshold actions. Omission preserves existing actions; [] clears them. Phase 1 supports NOTIFY on ordinary ORGANIZATION, DEFAULT_USER, and DEFAULT_AGENT policies, and only a singleton RESTRICT_MODELS action on DEFAULT_USER/*. No other action placements or actions-only rows are supported.

items.description: Phase 1 accepts NOTIFY only on ordinary ORGANIZATION, DEFAULT_USER, and DEFAULT_AGENT policies. Its at_percent must be an integer in (0, 100] and allow must be omitted. RESTRICT_MODELS is accepted only as the single DEFAULT_USER/* action, requires allow, and uses at_percent in [0, 100). BLOCK is response-only. Restricted continuation at 100 is not supported.

type.description: Action kind; BLOCK cannot be configured.

x-enumDescriptions.NOTIFY: Notify administrators at an integer percent greater than zero and at most 100.
x-enumDescriptions.RESTRICT_MODELS: Restrict access to allowlisted models at a percent from zero up to but not including 100.
x-enumDescriptions.BLOCK: Response-only action representing a hard cap at 100 percent.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.NOTIFY: Notify administrators at an integer percent greater than zero and at most 100.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.RESTRICT_MODELS: Restrict access to allowlisted models at a percent from zero up to but not including 100.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.BLOCK: Response-only action representing a hard cap at 100 percent.

type.title: PlatformUsageLimitActionType

at_percent.description: Percent that triggers the action. RESTRICT_MODELS uses the resolved limit plus current-period approved increases; NOTIFY uses the resolved base limit, matching the existing notification service.

allow.description: Required only for RESTRICT_MODELS; reads preserve legacy model IDs.

models.description: Distinct model IDs from the stored allowlist.

allow.title: PlatformUsageModelFilter

items.title: PlatformUsageLimitAction

client_id.description: Reserved all-clients policy key, not an aggregate counter.

actions.description: Zero or one premium restriction; an empty list clears it.

target.description: Ordinary policy; * is reserved for the premium policy.
Individual policy; actions are unavailable in phase 1.

actions.description: At most 20 configured threshold actions per assignment.
